The beginning

2031. The Earth’s economy is at the brink of collapsing.

The only way-out forthe human race is to relocate the economy into the metaverse.

The imminent opening of this new world promises to be lucrative. Everything is to be built... But also to be taken...!

The enthusiasm created by this new El Dorado has gone beyond expectation and has awakened mysterious creatures, asleep for millennia.

7777 mighty, fierce, and greedy dragons will do anything to steal the treasures of this new world.

To survive in this new technological world, each dragon needs a human.

7777 dragon eggs will be sent to the destination of human beings soon.
‍
Every human getting an egg will become a Dragon Master.

Therefore, they will benefit from all the wealth generated by their dragon.

ROADMAP

Release The Dragons

7777 Dragonz wake up from their slumber and each Dragonz family seek to take the power over the others.

Each family has their own strengths & weaknesses.

Try to catch one and become a Dragonz Master

Token Creation

The Clash of Dragonz token is under development. It will be used for the play to earn game (PtE).
‍
Each NFT holder will receive free tokens (amount will be announced on the discord).
‍
This token will be tradable on crypto exchanges.

P2E NFT Game

Each NFT holder will receive the character linked to his NFT, others people will have to pay to get one.
‍
The NFT's rarity and the family (fire, ice, earth, air, meta) will define specific powers, strengths and weaknesses of the character.
‍
Dragonz and their Master will battle for Supremacy in the Clash of Dragonz Arena.

PvE & PvP modes along with an accessories marketplace will be available to balance the game economy.

Players can monetize their gaming experiences through battle rewards using the game tokens.

The Metaverse

To offer the best gaming experience, after the public sale the NFT owners will be able to vote in which metaverse they would like to relocate the play-to-earn game (Sandbox, Decentraland, ...).
‍
With the royalties and the NFT sale benefits we will set up the Clash of Dragonz arena in one of those Metaverse.

The Metaverse

With the royalties and the NFT sale benefits we will set up the Clash of Dragonz arena in one of those Metaverse.

01.

Release the dragons
Dragons wake up from their slumber and seek to team up with a human. To make this association possible, many gifts will be droppped through Giveaways in order to select the 10,000 elected "Drakos".

02.

Crypto Currency Creation
A Crypto currency will be created and will have 2 main functions:
- It will be the currency used for the Play-to-Earn game.
- It will be the currency used in the future Metaverse.

03.

Play To Earn
After entering the Metaverse, the 5 dragon families fight for ultimate supremacy.
‍ - The game will feature dragon battles where your character will have the characteristics of your NFT.
- You will therefore have the opportunity to earn Tokens by playing or selling your character.

The stronger your character, the more profit you can make from it.

04.

The Metaverse
A Metaverse ecosystem will be created where the Play-to-Earn game will be relocated to.

Other possibilities are being analyzed.
A special team will be formed to develop the project.

You will be at the heart of the decisions with the implementation of a DAO.

FAQ

How do I get a Dragonz ?

First you'll get a Dragonz EGG.
On the reveal date, your egg will evolve into your Dragonz.

When MINT is available:
‍
1. CLICK on the MINT button.
2. METAMASK chrome extension will open and ask you to connect to the website.
3. Accept the transaction.
‍
You are now the original owner of a fabulous Clash Of Dragonz NFT.

Whitelist: the link will be displayed in a private discord channel for whitelisted members only.
‍

How many Dragonz will be available ?

Only 7777 Dragonz will be available. Each Dragon is unique and programmatically generated from 600+ hand drawn traits.

Among them, 12 outstanding 100% hand drawn masterpieces that represent Iconic characters.

Get a bundle and maximize your chance to get one of them!

WHAT IS THE PRICE?/WHY ARE THERE BUNDLES?

Our community’s interest is our priority!

Get more, pay less!

We are the FIRST NFT collection to propose a Bundles system that allows you to save more.

When you mint a bundle, you are guaranteed to get 3/5 Dragonz from different families.

With Bundle of 5, you are guaranteed to get a Dragonz from EACH FAMILY.


PRICES PER SALE:
‍
- Whitelist Price:
1 NFT x 0.05 ETH | 3 NFTs x 0.05 ETH | 5 NFTs x 0.05 ETH
‍
- Pre-Sale Price:
1 NFT x 0.06 ETH | 3 NFTs x 0.06 ETH | 5 NFTs x 0.05 ETH
‍
- Public Sale Price:
1 NFT x 0.07 ETH | 3 NFTs x 0.06 ETH | 5 NFTs x 0.05 ETH

what are the dragonz families?

There are 5 Dragonz Families:

- Earth
- Fire
- Ice
- Electric
- Meta

Each family has their own strengths & weaknesses.

These are key elements for the Play-to-Earn game.

12 Dragonz are iconic and don’t belong to any family.

These iconic dragonz will have special powers in the game.

When is the reveal ?

To be announced.
‍
When you mint your NFT, you first get an Egg.

At the Reveal (date to be confirmed soon), your Egg will automatically evolve into a Dragonz.

Where can I view my NFTs ?

Once minted, you'll just need to connect your wallet to OpenSea to view your NFTs.

What blockchain will you be using ?

The Ethereum Blockchain.

Will there be giveaways ?

Yes of course !

Amazing giveaways will be announced throughout the adventure!

Follow the Information section and stay connected to be informed.

what are the royalties?

5%.
